title: Overloaded calculator
description: Create two overloaded methods called calcular: one adds two integers, the other adds three integers.
hints: Both methods are called calcular but with a different number of parameters
The compiler chooses based on the number of arguments
solutionExplanation: Two methods with the same name but a different number of parameters.

title: Multiplier with type overloading
description: Create overloaded multiplicar: int*int, double*double, String repeated N times.
hints: Three methods with different parameter types
For the String use a for loop or StringBuilder
The compiler chooses based on the types
solutionExplanation: Three methods with the same name but different types. There is no ambiguity.

title: Overloaded temperature converter
description: Create overloaded convertir temperature: one returns a String with all units, the other converts between two specific units.
hints: Convert everything to Celsius as an intermediate step
Then from Celsius to the destination
Use a switch for each case
solutionExplanation: Both methods use Celsius as an intermediate step to simplify the combinations.
